Team — quick legal note on the SOW redlines: I reviewed SOW_Redwood_Draft_20280316.pdf and have three items that will affect signature timing if not resolved by EOD Mon 3/20:
1) Data retention term — Quantaretail requested 90 days for certain logs; we need to either accept or propose 180 days with an operational appendix.
2) Limitation of liability — the customer redline expands exposure; recommend we keep the standard carve and offer a capped addendum for the pilot only.
3) SLA uptime target — they asked 99.95% for the pilot; we should push to 99.9% with SLO-based credits until we cross 30 days at scale.

If we get confirmation on the signer and a commitment on data-retention/uptime tradeoffs today, I can clear legal to approve signoff and prepare the DocuSign packet for distribution on 3/22. If any of the three remain open after 3/20 close-of-business, we’ll need to shift the e-sign window.

Karthik
